purpose: Turn the already-required PAR calibration / vertical-profile / fouling pilot into fail-closed method criteria before any outcome-bearing optical deployment.
scientific_boundary: These are measurement-quality and representativeness gates, not biological light thresholds. Future TNC or meadow outcomes are prohibited from pilot decisions.
literature_basis: Collier et al. 2016 Frontiers in Marine Science 3:106, DOI 10.3389/fmars.2016.00106: cosine-corrected underwater PAR, reference calibration, 15-min logging, DLI.
The amount of light reaching the leaves in seagrass (Zostera marina) meadows, 2021: strong vertical decline in leaf-level PPFD within canopy.
LI-COR LI-192 manufacturer specification: immersion-designed cosine-corrected underwater quantum reference sensor.
Apogee underwater quantum sensor specifications: approximately +/-5% calibration uncertainty for current underwater quantum meters.

LI-COR LI-192 and LI-193 specifications distinguish hemispherical cosine-corrected PPFD from all-direction scalar photon flux fluence rate; the two sensor geometries measure different angular quantities and are not treated as interchangeable here.

calibration_gate.scope: Every sensor/channel intended for outcome-bearing within-canopy or above-canopy optical measurement must pass an in-water cross-calibration against one frozen underwater quantum reference with the SAME angular-response class as the primary measurement.
calibration_gate.required_range: Pilot must span darkness/near-zero and the full response-independently declared expected field range of the chosen primary photon-rate quantity without sensor saturation.
calibration_gate.sensor_specific_correction: One predeclared linear calibration per sensor/channel may be fit using pilot data only and is then frozen for the campaign.

side_by_side_dli_check.cv_definition: sample standard deviation / arithmetic mean of sensor-level integrated light within a check

calibration_gate.failure_action: Exclude the sensor/channel or repeat response-independent calibration after repair. Do not carry a failing channel into outcome-bearing deployment.

relative_error_definition.rationale: Near-zero/dark observations are handled by the separate dark-offset gate; a fixed 10 umol m-2 s-1 floor prevents undefined or arbitrarily large percentage error at zero light.

dark_reference_definition.metric: maximum absolute calibrated primary photon-rate reading across qualifying dark observations

expected_field_range_gate.rule: For every outcome-bearing sensor/channel, the largest reference photon-rate value in the calibration pilot must be at least the response-independently declared expected field maximum for the chosen angular-response quantity.

calibration_gate.angular_reference_boundary: Cross-class calibration between 2pi cosine PPFD and 4pi scalar PPFFR is prohibited in this v1 pilot because the quantities respond differently to the underwater angular light field.

vertical_representativeness_gate.canopy_structure_span: Select pilot nodes response-independently to span low, middle and high baseline canopy-height classes within the available core-three frame.
vertical_representativeness_gate.measurement: At each pilot node obtain simultaneous PAR at 25%, 50% and 75% of measured canopy height plus one above-canopy reference.
vertical_representativeness_gate.profile_reference: For each valid node-day, profile-reference DLI is the arithmetic mean of the 25%, 50% and 75% within-canopy DLIs.
vertical_representativeness_gate.selection_rule: Choose the single proportional level with the smallest median absolute relative error to profile-reference DLI across all valid pilot node-days; exact tie -> 0.50, then 0.25, then 0.75.
vertical_representativeness_gate.failure_action: The one-height optical primary is not field-ready. Do not pick the height with the strongest TNC association. A multi-height optical design would require a separately frozen future contract before outcome-bearing sampling.

valid_day_input_rule.rule: Only node-days already meeting the frozen daylight DLI QC are eligible for the vertical representativeness pilot.

canopy_height_class_gate.classification_rule: Assign baseline canopy-height class response-independently before any pilot PAR is inspected; class boundaries or node membership must be frozen in the pilot sampling manifest.

placement_repeatability_gate.tolerance_definition: Absolute vertical error from the selected proportional target must be <= max(0.02 m, 10% of measured canopy height).
placement_repeatability_gate.failure_action: Revise mounting hardware response-independently and repeat the pilot; do not widen tolerance after outcome-bearing deployment begins.

fouling_maintenance_gate.selection_rule: Test longest to shortest. Select the longest interval for which paired before-clean versus immediately-after-clean response differences remain within the frozen limits.
fouling_maintenance_gate.failure_action: If no manual-service interval passes, require an active antifouling/wiper solution to pass the same gate or disable the optical primary for the outcome-bearing campaign.
fouling_maintenance_gate.location_duration_rule: Each counted pilot location must have documented submergence through at least pilot day 14 under the candidate maintenance mode.

active_antifouling_fallback.rule: If none of the frozen manual intervals (14,7,3 d) passes, an active-antifouling/wiper configuration may be accepted only if >=6 locations / >=2 per bay are followed through >=14 submerged days and the same median<=5% / p90<=10% before-versus-after reference-check gate passes.

daily_dli_qc.daylight_definition: Astronomical local sunrise-to-sunset for each node/date; nighttime is integrated as zero but does not count toward daylight coverage.
daily_dli_qc.interpolation_rule: Only gaps <=30 minutes may be linearly interpolated; longer daylight gaps invalidate that node-day.
daily_dli_qc.overall_common_overlap_coverage_rule: Retain the existing >=85% overall PAR coverage and >=35-day common-overlap gates in the optical mechanism contract.

outputs_to_freeze_after_pilot: PAR sensor model(s) and sensor-specific calibration coefficients
reference sensor ID and calibration provenance
allowed placement tolerance and mounting geometry
daily DLI daylight-coverage and gap rule
above-canopy clearance tolerance if attribution module is confirmatory
no_rescue_rules: Do not select calibration coefficients, proportional height, cleaning interval, gap rule or sensor subset using TNC or future meadow response.
Do not weaken the 30-node / 8-per-bay optical primary gate because some channels fail pilot QC.
A response-independent pilot failure disables or redesigns the optical module before outcome-bearing sampling; it does not justify a smaller biological test.

optional_above_canopy_attribution.rule: above-canopy clearance tolerance is required only when optical_attribution_intent is confirmatory; if attribution is disabled, the pilot freeze must store the explicit token NOT_APPLICABLE_ATTRIBUTION_DISABLED and this does not block the within-canopy optical primary.

angular_response_gate.rule: Exactly one primary angular-response class must be declared before pilot validation, and the calibration reference class must match it exactly.
angular_response_gate.outcome_channel_rule: All declared outcome-bearing within-canopy channels are assumed to belong to the declared primary class; mixed angular-response classes in one primary are prohibited.
angular_response_gate.above_canopy_rule: If optical attribution is confirmatory, above-canopy reference channels must use the same primary class so within/above transmittance is a ratio of the same optical quantity.
angular_response_gate.failure_action: STOP_PILOT_QC_FAILED. Do not derive a cosine-to-scalar or scalar-to-cosine conversion from the biological campaign.

semantic_reporting.2pi_cosine_ppfd: hemispherical cosine-corrected PPFD; DLI in mol photons m-2 d-1
semantic_reporting.4pi_scalar_ppffr: scalar photosynthetic photon flux fluence rate / scalar photon irradiance; integrated scalar photon exposure in mol photons m-2 d-1
